input_fields.name: target_feature
input_fields.description: One semantically identified feature to make visible.

input_fields.name: visibility_goal
input_fields.description: One local visibility goal, including required neighboring context and acceptable occlusion.

input_fields.name: camera_adjustment_allowed
input_fields.description: Explicitly allowed orbit/pan/zoom adjustments for this one local view.

result_fields.name: local_feature_view
result_fields.description: Target feature, visibility goal, final camera/scale, neighboring context, and geometry-unchanged observation.

procedure: Resolve target_feature semantically and record visibility_goal before moving the camera.
Use the smallest calibrated Spin/Pan/Zoom or standard-view sequence permitted by camera_adjustment_allowed.
Stop after one focused local view makes the declared feature/context observable and return local_feature_view.
Record residual occlusion rather than compensating with geometry edits or an unbounded view search.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous target, missing visibility goal, disallowed camera adjustment, or a feature that remains unobservable.
Do not claim a multi-view acceptance plan from this one focused view.
Do not modify geometry to make the feature visible.
